summary: In the giant trees the rescue opens. A Titan's mouth closes on the Commander, and the column does not stop. Eren is reached. Ymir is not brought back.

segments.titleEn: A hunting ground in the branches
segments.ja: 巨木の森は、追う者たちの装置が一番速くなる場所です。速くなる枝の上で、目標は鎧の腕の中のエレンです。エレンを切り離す手順は、前の遠征の待機とは逆です。逆である理由は、日没が先に来るからです。先に来る期限を、リヴァイは各班の位置に分配します。分配された位置に、ミカサは一番近い線を取ります。取る線は、友人を見る線でもあります。
segments.en: The forest of giant trees is where the hunters' gear becomes fastest. On the branches where it becomes fast, the target is Eren inside the armor's arm. The procedure for separating Eren is the reverse of the waiting in the previous expedition. The reason it is the reverse is that sunset arrives first. Levi distributes the deadline that arrives first into each squad's position. Mikasa takes the nearest line among the distributed positions. The line she takes is also a line that looks at a friend.

segments.ja: ベルトルトは、エレンを確保した側にいながら、枝の上の顔を見ています。見ている顔は、殺す対象のリストと、飯を分けたリストが重なっています。重なったリストを、アルミンは言葉でさらに揺らします。揺らす内容は、罪の自覚ではなく、こちらに残る選択です。選択を、ベルトルトはすぐには取れません。取れない揺れが、超大型の蒸気を遅らせます。遅れた蒸気が、救出の隙間です。
segments.en: Bertholdt, while on the side that has secured Eren, is looking at the faces in the branches. The faces he looks at overlap the list of people to kill and the list of people he shared meals with. Armin shakes the overlapped list further with words. What he shakes it with is not an awareness of sin. It is the choice to remain on this side. Bertholdt cannot take the choice at once. The wavering he cannot take delays the Colossal's steam. The delayed steam is the gap of the rescue.

segments.ja: アルミンが使う信用は、相手を赦す信用ではありません。まだ人間の反応が残っている、という観測です。観測を、ベルトルトは侮辱とも救いとも受け取りかねます。受け取りかねる顔が、ライナーの任務とずれます。ずれた顔を、ユミルは別の計算で見ます。見る計算は、ヒストリアをこの森の殺害から外すことです。外すには、自分が戦士側の取引材料になる必要があります。必要を、彼女はまだ実行の直前に置いています。
segments.en: The trust Armin uses is not trust that forgives the opponent. It is an observation that a human response still remains. Bertholdt can hardly receive the observation as either an insult or a salvation. The face that can hardly receive it slips from Reiner's mission. Ymir looks at the slipped face with a different calculation. The calculation she looks with is to take Historia out of the killing in this forest. To take her out, Ymir herself has to become material for a trade on the warrior side. She still has that necessity placed just before the carrying-out.

segments.ja: ユミルは、枝の上からクリスタの位置を確認します。確認は、戦術の点ではなく、生きて帰す点です。帰す相手の名は、もう役の名だけではありません。ではありませんが、森の騒音の中ではヒストリアより短い呼び方が先に出ます。先に出た呼び方を、彼女は自分への命令にします。命令は、この人を壁の内に残せ、です。残せないなら、自分が代わりに外へ出る、です。
segments.en: From the branches, Ymir checks Christa's position. The check is not a point of tactics. It is the point of sending her back alive. The name of the person to send back is no longer only the name of a role. Even so, in the noise of the forest the shorter way of calling comes out ahead of Historia. She makes the way of calling that came out first into an order to herself. The order is: leave this person inside the walls. If you cannot leave her, you go outside in her place.

segments.ja: 追撃の情報の中に、ラガコの名が混ざります。混ざる理由は、コニーの村に穴が無く、人の代わりに巨人が残っていたからです。残っていた事実を、ハンジの系譜の疑問として列は共有し始めます。共有は、まだ結論ではありません。結論でない名を、アルミンは鎧の正体と同じ棚に置きます。置く棚は、壁の外から人が来て、内側の人間を巨人にできる、という恐ろしい仮説です。仮説は、今日の救出を止めません。
segments.en: The name Ragako mixes into the information of the pursuit. The reason it mixes is that Connie's village had no hole, and Titans remained in place of people. The column starts to share the fact that remained as a question in Hange's line. The sharing is not a conclusion yet. Armin sets the name that is not a conclusion on the same shelf as the armor's identity. The shelf he sets it on is a frightening hypothesis: people came from outside the walls and can turn the humans inside into Titans. The hypothesis does not stop today's rescue.

segments.en: Erwin advances the column without detouring around the Titans on the flank. The speed of advancing is a speed that accepts the danger of a mouth opening. segments.en: A Titan's mouth opens and closes near the front of the column. As a result of the closing, the Commander's arm is lost from the line of battle. The column does not make what was lost into a reason to stop. Not making it one is the cruel accuracy of this scene. The accuracy is maintained by the next advance Erwin shouts. Inside the maintained advance, the injury is both an object of rescue and an obstacle to speed. A soldier beside him processes the obstacle, briefly. After the processing, the forest is still not hiding the target.

Ahead of the flight is the direction of their hometown. The direction has not been given to anyone inside the walls as an accurate map. The Survey Corps does not finish chasing the map that has not been given, not today. The reason they do not finish is injury, sunset, and the Titans on the flank. The Titans do not leave the column even after the mouth closed.

vocab.exampleEn: The forest of giant trees is where the hunters' gear becomes fastest. On the branches where it becomes fast, the target is Eren inside the armor's arm.
